name: verify-claudecode-nvim
description: Drive the real claudecode.nvim plugin in a real Neovim (an agent-tty terminal) while a scripted WebSocket client (scripts/ws-client.mjs) plays the Claude Code CLI over the plugin's WebSocket MCP server, and capture screen text, PNG screenshots, WebM video, JSON-RPC traffic, and file state as evidence. Use to prove a claudecode.nvim feature works end to end (openDiff accept/reject, openFile, selection tracking, :ClaudeCodeSend at-mentions, closing diffs) without the claude CLI or network. Also us
author: coder
